impact: Logging the first set of a session creates the session, waits for the id, then posts the set. On Cloud Run with min-instances 0, the first request also pays a cold start, so the very first tap of a workout is the slowest interaction in the app. No mutation anywhere uses optimistic updates, so every logged set waits for a full round-trip before the UI moves.
title: No optimistic updates: the first set of a session costs two sequential round-trips
